name: LPC Grave Markers (remix)
text:
Name:
  LPC Grave Markers Rework
Version:
  1.3
Description:
  Some LPC grave markers merged into a single set & reworked
  for use in Stendhal.
Tileset details:
  - Designed for use with 32x32 tiled maps.
  - Orientation: orthogonal
  - Shadowless PNG images use indexed color (smaller files).
  - Shadowed images & GIMP sources (.xcf) use RGB color.
Licensing:
  - Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA) version 3.0 or later (see: LICENSE-CC-BY-SA-3.0.txt)
  - GNU General Public License (GPL) version 3.0 or later (see: LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt)
Copyright/Attribution:
  Created by Barbara Rivera, Casper Nilsson, Carlo Enrico Victoria, Tuomo Untinen,
  ak-blanc, Johann C, & Jordan Irwin (AntumDeluge)
Links/Sources:
  - Stendhal: https://stendhalgame.org/
  - OpenGameArt.org submission: https://opengameart.org/node/81422
  - LPC art entries: https://opengameart.org/lpc-art-entries
  - See also: sources.md
